prompt:
Use case ui-mockup. Create a crisp, high-fidelity LANDSCAPE 3:2 board of FOUR flat UI screens for Jazz Ear Lab: desktop M2 Practice top-left, portrait mobile M2 Practice top-right, desktop Insights bottom-left, portrait mobile Insights bottom-right. Desktop screens wider than portrait phone screens; each phone has a 390x844 aspect. No hardware, perspective or photography. The attached image is the APPROVED VISUAL IDENTITY reference: carry over BLACK navigation with white humanist sans text, restrained YELLOW #FFCC00 current-task/action bands, WHITE evidence workspace, quiet gray rules, flat 2px rectangular controls. NO rebranding, new fonts, palette changes, gradients or decorative art. Change composition only as described below. Product is a usable listening tool, not a landing page. Preserve compact headings, zero letter spacing, 44px target intent, all controls legible.
EXACT content in every Practice: Jazz Ear Lab nav Practice / Insights / Legacy; M2 Recognition, Question 4 / 20, Stop in session header; C7; Which chord degree?; Your turn; Replay. Exactly 12 equally unselected answers in row-major order: 1, b9, 9, b3, 3, 11, #11, 5, b13, 13, b7, maj7. Desktop 6 columns x2 rows, phone 4x3. No answer revealed, no Reveal or Next before resolution. Collapsed Session settings. No waveform, staff, keyboard, timer, streak or microphone.
EXACT Insights: heading Insights and visible Example data label. READ-ONLY scope M2 Recognition / Context on / Previously seen / 18-24 Oct 2026 / All matching sessions. Root All and Quality 7 are the ONLY filter selectors. Main First-answer accuracy 70%, 28/40 assessed, 2 unassessed. SMALLER supporting text Replay-assisted 8/40; Correct-response median 2.4s, valid n=24. Patterns worth attention: 7/b7 60%, 12/20, replay-assisted 5/20, adjacent Customize focus; 7/3 80%,16/20,replay-assisted 3/20. If bars used, visibly exactly 60% and 80% of identical tracks. Caption: Descriptive pattern, not a confirmed weakness. Then collapsed Detailed breakdown and Sessions. No other explanation, invented specific confusions, mastery, trend or claims. Scope then accuracy then patterns/action then details. Mobile may continue the second pattern below fold but primary action visible. ALL numbers illustrative.
COMPOSITION: A desktop two-zone listening workbench rather than a centered stack: compact black top nav and shallow full-width yellow exercise/progress/Stop strip. Under it desktop has chord C7, prompt, Your turn and Replay in an open LEFT task anchor taking one third width; a generous 6x2 degree grid occupies the RIGHT two thirds, aligned to the chord block, no enclosing cards, no divider wall. Session settings is a low-priority full-width disclosure below. On PHONE collapse into the same semantic order, left-aligned chord and prompt followed by Replay and a 4x3 grid; do NOT squeeze desktop columns into the phone. Insights uses a readable two-zone desktop layout WITH clear top-to-bottom evidence order: scope/filter row full width, then a narrow left overview dominated by 70% with 28/40 and unassessed; adjacent wider evidence area starts with smaller replay/time then Patterns worth attention and two labeled rows, Customize focus beside the 7/b7 row; full-width details below. No chart above overview and no new permanent sidebar. Phone becomes scope -> full accuracy with denominators -> small replay/time -> patterns with inline focus command -> details. Black/white field and restrained yellow command are unchanged; no extra labels or visual noise.
